teaching.description: Twihwereje hamwe ijambo ryo kwizera dufatiye kuri Abeli na Henoki. Ivy'ukwizera kwabo turabisoma mu gitabo c'Itanguriro, mu cete candikiwe Abaheburayo naho ivy'abo babiri turabisanga mu gice ca 11: 4 - 5 . Ku vy'Abeli twarumvise ko ikimazi ciwe cemewe n'Imana kubera ko yagize ukwizera akagitanga nk'uko Imana igomba. Vyari bikenewe yuko Aburahamu ava mub'iwabo nta kindi bari bamumariye atari ukumumenyereza imigenzo yabo y'ugusenga ibigigwamana. Imama rero yagomba yuko Aburahamu asiga abandi bose akazobana n'umugore wiwe Sara maze Imana ikabona kubahezagira. Ntiyaretse kubishitsa kuko yahavuye ibaha umuhugu mu busaza bwabo uwitwa Isaka .Ikindi twokwibukirako ku kwizera guhambaye kw'Aburahamu, ni ca gihe Imana yamubwira gutanga umuhungu wiwe kw'ikimazi maze Aburahamu nawe ntiyahigimanze. Maze Imana imaze kubona ukwizera guhambaye kw'Aburahamu, yaciye inyaruka igihe kigeze uwo muhugu atarapfa. Isaka Imana ntiyashimye yuko apfa maze akomeza kubana na se na nyina. Wari umuryango uriko imihezagiro y'Imana.

Twaribukanije ingene ugupfa kwa Yesu kwatumye abantu baronka uburenganzira bwo kwishikira imbere y'Imana gusenga. Imbere yuko Yesu aza ngo apfe ,abaherezi nibo baserukira abantu ku Mana mu kubatangira ibimazi mw'ihema ryayo. Abaherezi bo mw'isi batangira abantu amaraso y'impene n'amapfizi atashobora guma abahinduka ngo bave mu vyaha ariko Umwami Yesu we yatanze amaraso yiwe yisezerano rishasha ku musaraba. Umwami Yesu rero niwe yitanze nk'ikimazi gishobora gukuraho ivyaha.
teaching.name: Ubuherezi bukuru bw'umwami Yesu
